description: This file defines a Moose role 'Coocook::Helpers' that provides various helper methods for Catalyst controllers, including URI handling, capability checks, redirection, and session messaging.

classes.name: Coocook::Helpers
classes.description: A Moose role providing helper methods for Catalyst controllers, including URI manipulation, capability checks, redirection, and session messaging.

methods.name: current_uri_local_part
methods.description: Returns the URI for the current request with only the app-local part, suitable for passing to uri_for_local_part.

methods.name: json_stash
methods.description: Shortcut to store or access JSON data in the controller's stash under 'json_stash'.

methods.name: uri_for_local_part
methods.description: Constructs a URI string by concatenating the request's base URI with a local path.

methods.name: uri_for_action_if_permitted
methods.description: Generates a URI for a given action if the current user has the required capabilities; returns undef otherwise.

methods.name: has_capability
methods.description: Checks if the current user has a specific capability, optionally using provided input data.

methods.name: require_capability
methods.description: Ensures the user has a specific capability; redirects or detaches if not authorized.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Returns the Messages object associated with the current session.

methods.name: project_uri
methods.description: Constructs a project-specific URI including project ID and URL name, with additional path arguments and query parameters.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Returns the current project object from stash.

methods.name: redirect_canonical_case
methods.description: Redirects to a URL with a canonical case for a specific path argument if the current case differs.

methods.name: redirect_detach
methods.description: Performs an HTTP redirect and detaches from the Catalyst request flow.

methods.name: redirect_uri_for_action
methods.description: Generates a URI for an action, adding a redirect parameter to the current URI.

methods.name: user_registration_enabled
methods.description: Determines if user registration is enabled based on configuration and whether any users exist.
